description: A generated sales and revenue report covering a single reporting period
label: Sales report

period_label.label: Period
period_label.description: Human-readable label for the reporting period, e.g. 'Aug 18-24, 2026'.

period_start.label: Period start
period_start.description: Inclusive start of the reporting window.

period_end.label: Period end
period_end.description: Exclusive end of the reporting window.

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: Currency the monetary totals are reported in.

order_count.label: Orders
order_count.description: Number of paid, non-canceled orders in the period.

item_quantity.label: Items sold
item_quantity.description: Total quantity of items across all counted orders.

sub_total.label: Subtotal
sub_total.description: Sum of order subtotals before discounts, tax and shipping.

discount_total.label: Discounts
discount_total.description: Total discounts applied across counted orders.

shipping_total.label: Shipping
shipping_total.description: Total shipping charged across counted orders, after shipping discounts.

tax_total.label: Tax
tax_total.description: Total tax collected across counted orders.

grand_total.label: Revenue
grand_total.description: Total charged across counted orders, less refunds made on them.

cancelled_count.label: Canceled orders
cancelled_count.description: Orders created in the period that were canceled.

unpaid_count.label: Unpaid orders
unpaid_count.description: Orders created in the period that are not yet paid.

refund_total.label: Refunds
refund_total.description: Refunded so far on counted orders. Already taken out of revenue.

new_customer_count.label: New customers
new_customer_count.description: Distinct accounts whose first counted order fell in this period.

returning_customer_count.label: Returning customers
returning_customer_count.description: Distinct accounts in this period that had ordered before it.

prev_order_count.label: Previous period orders
prev_order_count.description: Order count for the previous period (day, week, 14 days or calendar month).

prev_grand_total.label: Previous period revenue
prev_grand_total.description: Revenue for the previous period (day, week, 14 days or calendar month).

revenue_change_pct.label: Revenue change %
revenue_change_pct.description: Percent change in revenue versus the previous period. Null when there is no prior revenue to compare against.

order_change_pct.label: Order change %
order_change_pct.description: Percent change in order count versus the previous period. Null when there were no prior orders.

top_products.label: Top products
top_products.description: Best-selling products in the period, ranked by revenue.

customers_truncated.label: New and returning partial
customers_truncated.description: Set when the period had more customers than the new and returning split reads, so both counts are a lower bound.

top_products_truncated.label: Top products partial
top_products_truncated.description: Set when the period had more paid orders than the ranking reads, so the list is partial.

daily_totals.label: Daily breakdown
daily_totals.description: Per-day order count and revenue across the period.

summary.label: Summary
summary.description: Display only: the dashboard draws the headline figures here from the report's other fields. Never stored.

types.description: A new sales report was generated for a reporting period.
